#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
echo ">>> [backend/dashboard-api] Installing Python test dependencies..."

fi
echo ">>> [backend/dashboard-api] Running tests..."
export DATABASE_URL="sqlite+aiosqlite:///:memory:"

mkdir -p coverage
python -m pytest tests/ --tb=short -q \
  --cov=. --cov-report=term-missing \
  --cov-report=json:coverage/coverage.json \
  --no-header 2>&1 | tee /tmp/test_out_backend_dashboard-api.txt
EXIT_CODE=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
echo ">>> [backend/dashboard-api] Done."
exit $EXIT_CODE
